summary.text: Welwitschia is a monotypic genus of gymnosperms, the sole described species being the distinctive Welwitschia mirabilis, endemic to the Namib desert within Namibia and Angola. (Fixture text standing in for the CC BY-SA extract.) A monotypic genus shares its article with its one species, so this is the species page's paragraph again.
